$comment: Production-dependency advisories that ship knowingly, read by
scripts/check-dependency-audit.mjs. An entry excuses one advisory from the
gate and is reported on every run, so an exemption stays visible.
Each entry needs: id (GHSA identifier) or package, reason (what the
hostile case actually is here, not 'not exploitable'), and revisit (a date
past which the gate reports it as stale). An entry with no revisit date is
Empty is the correct state. Upgrade first; record only what cannot be.
